declarations.name: payment_reconcile.Reconcile.internal_matched_iff
declarations.signature:
∀ (I E : List payment_reconcile.rules.Record) (x : payment_reconcile.rules.Record),
  @Membership.mem payment_reconcile.rules.Record (List payment_reconcile.rules.Record)
      (@List.instMembership payment_reconcile.rules.Record) I x →
    Iff (@Eq Nat (payment_reconcile.Reconcile.rowCode I E x) (@OfNat.ofNat Nat (nat_lit 0) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 0))))
      (And
        (@Eq Nat (@List.length payment_reconcile.rules.Record (payment_reconcile.Reconcile.withKey I x.key))
          (@OfNat.ofNat Nat (nat_lit 1) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 1))))
        (∃ e,
          And
            (@Eq (List payment_reconcile.rules.Record) (payment_reconcile.Reconcile.withKey E x.key)
              (@List.cons payment_reconcile.rules.Record e (@List.nil payment_reconcile.rules.Record)))
            (And (@Eq Aeneas.Std.U32 e.currency x.currency)
              (And (@Eq Aeneas.Std.U64 e.amount x.amount) (@Eq Aeneas.Std.U32 e.status x.status)))))

declarations.name: payment_reconcile.Reconcile.exception_reported_once
declarations.signature:
∀ (I E : List payment_reconcile.rules.Record) (x y : payment_reconcile.rules.Record),
  @Eq (List payment_reconcile.rules.Record) (payment_reconcile.Reconcile.withKey I x.key)
      (@List.cons payment_reconcile.rules.Record x (@List.nil payment_reconcile.rules.Record)) →
    @Eq (List payment_reconcile.rules.Record) (payment_reconcile.Reconcile.withKey E x.key)
        (@List.cons payment_reconcile.rules.Record y (@List.nil payment_reconcile.rules.Record)) →
      @Eq Aeneas.Std.U64 y.key x.key →
        Not
            (And (@Eq Aeneas.Std.U32 y.currency x.currency)
              (And (@Eq Aeneas.Std.U64 y.amount x.amount) (@Eq Aeneas.Std.U32 y.status x.status))) →
          And
            (Or
              (@Eq Nat (payment_reconcile.Reconcile.rowCode I E x)
                (@OfNat.ofNat Nat (nat_lit 1) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 1))))
              (Or
                (@Eq Nat (payment_reconcile.Reconcile.rowCode I E x)
                  (@OfNat.ofNat Nat (nat_lit 2) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 2))))
                (@Eq Nat (payment_reconcile.Reconcile.rowCode I E x)
                  (@OfNat.ofNat Nat (nat_lit 3) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 3))))))
            (@Eq Nat (payment_reconcile.Reconcile.extCode I E y)
              (@OfNat.ofNat Nat (nat_lit 0) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 0))))

declarations.name: payment_reconcile.Reconcile.specInternal
declarations.signature: payment_reconcile.rules.Record → Nat → Nat → Option payment_reconcile.rules.Record → Nat
declarations.definition:
fun r ic ec first =>
  if ic > 1 then 6
  else
    match first with
    | none => 4
    | some e =>
      if ec > 1 then 5
      else
        if e.currency ≠ r.currency then 2 else if e.amount ≠ r.amount then 1 else if e.status ≠ r.status then 3 else 0

declarations.name: payment_reconcile.Reconcile.rowCode.eq_1
declarations.signature:
∀ (I E : List payment_reconcile.rules.Record) (x : payment_reconcile.rules.Record),
  @Eq Nat (payment_reconcile.Reconcile.rowCode I E x)
    (payment_reconcile.Reconcile.specInternal x
      (@List.length payment_reconcile.rules.Record (payment_reconcile.Reconcile.withKey I x.key))
      (@List.length payment_reconcile.rules.Record (payment_reconcile.Reconcile.withKey E x.key))
      (@List.find? payment_reconcile.rules.Record
        (fun y =>
          @Decidable.decide (@Eq Aeneas.Std.U64 y.key x.key)
            (Aeneas.Std.instDecidableEqUScalar_1 Aeneas.Std.UScalarTy.U64 y.key x.key))
        E))

declarations.name: payment_reconcile.Reconcile.specExternal
declarations.signature: Nat → Nat → Nat
declarations.definition: fun ic ec => if ic = 0 then 7 else if ic > 1 then 6 else if ec > 1 then 5 else 0

declarations.signature:

      (@List.length payment_reconcile.rules.Record (payment_reconcile.Reconcile.withKey E y.key)))

declarations.name: payment_reconcile.Reconcile.specInternal.eq_2
declarations.signature:
∀ (r : payment_reconcile.rules.Record) (ic ec : Nat) (e : payment_reconcile.rules.Record),
  @Eq Nat (payment_reconcile.Reconcile.specInternal r ic ec (@Option.some payment_reconcile.rules.Record e))
    (@ite Nat (@GT.gt Nat instLTNat ic (@OfNat.ofNat Nat (nat_lit 1) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 1))))
      (Nat.decLt (@OfNat.ofNat Nat (nat_lit 1) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 1))) ic)
      (@OfNat.ofNat Nat (nat_lit 6) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 6)))
      (@ite Nat (@GT.gt Nat instLTNat ec (@OfNat.ofNat Nat (nat_lit 1) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 1))))
        (Nat.decLt (@OfNat.ofNat Nat (nat_lit 1) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 1))) ec)
        (@OfNat.ofNat Nat (nat_lit 5) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 5)))
        (@ite Nat (@Ne Aeneas.Std.U32 e.currency r.currency)
          (@instDecidableNot (@Eq Aeneas.Std.U32 e.currency r.currency)
            (Aeneas.Std.instDecidableEqUScalar_1 Aeneas.Std.UScalarTy.U32 e.currency r.currency))
          (@OfNat.ofNat Nat (nat_lit 2) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 2)))
          (@ite Nat (@Ne Aeneas.Std.U64 e.amount r.amount)
            (@instDecidableNot (@Eq Aeneas.Std.U64 e.amount r.amount)
              (Aeneas.Std.instDecidableEqUScalar_1 Aeneas.Std.UScalarTy.U64 e.amount r.amount))
            (@OfNat.ofNat Nat (nat_lit 1) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 1)))
            (@ite Nat (@Ne Aeneas.Std.U32 e.status r.status)
              (@instDecidableNot (@Eq Aeneas.Std.U32 e.status r.status)
                (Aeneas.Std.instDecidableEqUScalar_1 Aeneas.Std.UScalarTy.U32 e.status r.status))
              (@OfNat.ofNat Nat (nat_lit 3) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 3)))
              (@OfNat.ofNat Nat (nat_lit 0) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 0))))))))
